description.value: Anie's Pizza & Bakery is a small owner-operated restaurant in Cache Creek sitting along the Cariboo Highway (also known as the Gold Trail), serving made-from-scratch pizza with hand-tossed dough, home-baked bread, and freshly rolled cinnamon buns. The kitchen locally sources produce and deli meats and makes everything in-house, from custom pizzas to sandwiches built on house-baked loaves. Catering is available, and the location on a major Interior BC highway makes it a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through.
